definitions.quantum teleportation: A protocol whereby the quantum state of a particle, e.g., photon, is transferred from photon 1 to photon 2 via a second pair of entangled photons.
definitions.quantum state recovery (qsr): the portion of the teleportation protocol that recovers the quantum state using bsmResult and eprId.
definitions.quantum router: A novel device that extends existing digital network forwarding concepts to the routing of quantum states.
